_meta.note: VW source = fuse appears in the car's current-flow data (wins on conflicts). 'chart' = third-party Mk5 fuse chart transcribed from VW owner/workshop info. Allocations change at May/Nov 2005 and by equipment — VERIFY against the card in the fuse lid. SB chart used = engine-bay fuse box version 'up to May 2005' (matches the BLX data: SB11 25A Motronic, SB12 15A lambda BLX, SB24 gateway, SB28 20A gearbox, SB31 wiper).

locations.SB: Fuse holder B, engine compartment E-box on the battery, left side.
locations.SA: Pre-fuse holder A (high-current strip) on the battery/E-box.
locations.R: Relay carrier on J519 under the dash (driver side), plus additional carrier in the E-box.
